description: This file contains the implementation of the 'DefaultMetadataHeaderKey' class, which models metadata header keys with parsing, validation, and comparison functionalities within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetadataHeaderKey for handling metadata header key parsing, validation, and comparison logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a character sequence into a DefaultMetadataHeaderKey instance, ensuring non-null and format validity.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultMetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer, validating the path structure.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Internal method that enforces rules on the JsonPointer path, such as non-empty, correct wildcard usage, and structure.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Checks if the key applies to all leaves (i.e., if the path starts with a wildcard).

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the specific JsonPointer path associated with this header key, handling wildcard cases.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key with another based on the path and wildcard presence, used for sorting or ordering keys.

methods.name: comparePaths
methods.description: Helper method that compares two JsonPointer paths lexicographically.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the JsonPointer path.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the path.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the JsonPointer path.
